Tests breaking on breakpoints inside a generator with yield*.
function* f() {
  #yield* g();                    // B1
  if (break_count !== 2) throw new Error('Expected break_count === 2');  // B2

  yield* g();                    // B1
  #if (break_count !== 2) throw new Error('Expected break_count === 2');  // B2
  return 1;                      // B3

  if (break_count !== 2) throw new Error('Expected break_count === 2');  // B2
  #return 1;                      // B3
}

hasException: false
break_count: 3
